feudal_map_notes: Bridge 1.1.0 is now included on clients for Shift-click estate cards. Replace the old server bridge. ADM IDs pin the exact new client JAR; validation settings are unchanged.
world_rules_notes: Server-only empirecraft_world_rules 1.0.2; requires CombatLog 2.8.4 and Mohist 71a84ff7 / Forge 47.4.23. Client JARs and ADM unchanged.
Disables enchantments, vanilla brewing and Overgeared arrow effects; keeps ordinary metal arrows and mod wine/beer systems.
Natural crops and fruit trees renew only in loaded Towny wilderness chunks of configured worlds. Lapis-to-salt conversion is removed.
Create doors/trapdoors cannot be crafted, placed or manually used. Optional client KubeJS overlay hides them and effect arrows in JEI.
Build, exact-JAR Mixin tests, NBT/Towny fixtures and installation: world-rules/ and validation/world-rules-1.0.2.md; gameplay validation remains required.
sailing_notes: Valkyrien Sails 0.3.2-empirecraft.5: furled cloth counted separately; gentle adaptive coasting to up to 2 blocks/s depending on sail area, mass and wind; pilot reverse below 1.5 blocks/s up to 1.5; JourneyMap 6 mounted-player entity/camera heading compatibility. Existing 18 blocks/s open-sail target, persistent wheel, size-based turning and anchor retained. Identical client/server Sails and matching ADM; JourneyMap/VS JARs unchanged. See sails/ARCADE.md and validation/sails-empirecraft.5.json.
content_policy_notes: Server-only content policy; client KubeJS JEI and creative overlay required for display. Native Spawn/Boomsticks/Knights/Overgeared JARs and client ADM unchanged.
forging_balance_notes: Install identical forging addon and refreshed calendar JAR on server and all clients. Original Overgeared/Boomsticks JARs are retained; equipment rules and recipes are built into the forging addon.
titles_notes: 39 cosmetic titles via /titles; install matching resource JAR on every client. Does not replace political /title.
